title: Phoenix swap-in

forms: IF <n> CSV DROP ELSE key CHECKSIGVERIFY ENDIF key CHECKSIG
the same script with CLTV in place of CSV

note: The check matches IF, a small delay, CSV or CLTV, DROP, ELSE, a compressed key, CHECKSIGVERIFY, ENDIF, a compressed key, CHECKSIG. That is Phoenix swap-in version 1, in both refund forms. Not an insert package.
